name: gamepulse
description: GamePulse - High-performance Discord game presence network with Cloudflare D1 control plane and Rust workers

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @gamepulse/shared run build && pnpm --filter @gamepulse/admin run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @gamepulse/shared run typecheck && pnpm --filter @gamepulse/admin run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @gamepulse/shared run lint && pnpm --filter @gamepulse/admin run lint
scripts.check:all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run cargo:check && pnpm run cargo:test
